verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents its own fan-out capability: a single Company Profile update automatically changes company records across all jurisdictions and compliance areas. It also files annual reports automatically in every state as they come due. Both act on many items from one trigger, but neither is a general user-driven bulk operation, and the API evidence shows no batch endpoints. Missing for 10: batch/bulk API endpoints, user-selectable multi-item actions (bulk edit/delete/export), self-serve bulk import (import is a done-for-you service), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
